title: 找到走法不等于赢棋：XiangqiBench 面向 LLM Agent 的闭环评估基准
summary: 论文提出 XiangqiBench，一个可执行的中国象棋基准，从119个战术残局出发，要求 LLM Agent 在引擎防守下完成将死。基于12个前沿模型的8568条多轮轨迹，揭示三种看似胜任实则高估闭环成功的信号：转换差距、一致性差距与模拟差距，主张 Agent 评估应关注闭环结果与可靠性。
summary_en: The paper introduces XiangqiBench, an executable Chinese chess benchmark where LLM agents must deliver checkmate against an engine defender starting from 119 tactical endgames. Using 8,568 multi-turn trajectories from 12 frontier LLMs, it reveals three signals that overstate closed-loop success: the Conversion Gap, Consistency Gap, and Simulation Gap, arguing agent evaluations should score closed-loop outcomes and report reliability alongside coverage.
